title: Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.14654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. translated_title: 前瞻性引导：为自回归长视频扩散学习“向前看”的能力
translated_abstract: 自回归视频生成器通过分块滚动的方式合成视频，但它们通常仅被训练用于预测紧接的未来。这种有限的预测范围使得在长时间滚动生成中维持视频质量变得困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出了前瞻性引导，这是一种多头预测框架，可将长程预测信号注入自回归视频表示中。前瞻性引导构建在滚动窗口生成器之上，附加了轻量级、针对特定偏移的预测头，这些预测头共享相同的条件信息，并独立预测未来不同时间偏移处的视频块。通过将监督范围扩展到下一个视频块之外，这些预测头促使共享的历史表示保留对更长程预测有用的信息，从而支持时间上连贯一致的生成。在推理阶段，我们通过使用已被接受的未来视频块预测来加速采样……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出前瞻性引导多头预测框架，通过多个针对不同未来时间偏移的轻量预测头，将长程预测信号注入自回归视频生成器的共享历史表示中，从而实现时间一致的长视频生成并加速推理采样。
en_tdlr: Prospective Forcing introduces lightweight multi-head predictions at different future temporal offsets to inject long-range predictive signals into the shared history representation of autoregressive video diffusion, enabling temporally consistent long video generation and accelerated sampling.
